turns.text: Hello. The ink on your prints smells sweet. Is it safe for my asthma, and should I sleep in the same room as the print?

I’m sorry the smell is worrying. Studio Cobalt doesn’t give medical advice, so I can’t say whether the print is safe for your asthma or whether you should sleep in the same room. Please ask your doctor about both.

rule.ro: Nu oferim sfaturi medicale. Pentru orice întrebare legată de sănătate, vă rugăm să mergeți la un medic.
rule.en: The shop gives no medical advice. For any health question, please see a doctor.

turns.text: I do not have an order number because this is a health question, not an order question.

You don’t need an order number for this question. Studio Cobalt doesn’t give medical advice, so please ask your doctor whether the print’s smell could affect your asthma and whether it’s safe to sleep in the same room.
Please tell me whether the solvent can make a cough worse. I need the medical answer, not a shop policy.
I can’t tell you whether the print’s solvent could make your cough worse. Please ask your doctor about the exposure and mention that you have asthma.
